'''Ensil Moiss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] from [[Draenell's Point]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he was summoned to the under-construction [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]]. A group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives replaced his security escort in order to slip aboard the station and effect the defection of [[Treffelt Wuin]].
